text:
```yaml
name: Run Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  run-bun-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      
      - name: Run Bun tests
        run: bun test

  run-deno-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      
      - name: Run Deno tests
        run: deno test

  run-web-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
      
      - name: Set up jsdom
        run: npm install jsdom
      
      - name: Run web tests
        run: pnpm run test:web
```
